main_text.p: tio nouitatis aliquid habebit, &iucunditatis, proferemus. Quoniam autem illud Ciceronis &Cornificij perobscurum uidetur, neque fine ali-qua attentione adhibita in-telligitur,illud potisimū ex-ponemus. Ex ratiocinatione nascitur controuersia, cum ex eo quod uspiam est, ad id quod nusquam scriptum est, peruenitur.hoc pacto:Lex,si furiosus est, agnatum genti-liumque in eo pecuniaque e-ius potestas esto. Et lex: Pa-terfamilias utifuper familia, pecuniaq; sua legassit, ita ius esto. Ex lex: Si paterfamilias intestato moritur, familia pe-

page.notes: Handwritten or Hebrew-like ink marks in the left margin (beside "qua attentione", "telligitur", "ponemus", "nascitur") and a small mark at the foot left of "pe-" were not transcribed; they are not printed text. The "»" marks at the left of the quoted law lines are typographic markers and were not transcribed as text. The running head is decorative and not legible; marked illegible. "perobscurum" and "Ciceronis" are joined where the line break carries no printed hyphen. "utifuper" is printed as such.
